title: Dancing With the Wind (바람을 붙잡고 춤을 췄구나) - Character Bible

rules.single_protagonist: Exactly one protagonist appears in every shot unless the shot explicitly lists other characters.
rules.identity_anchor: Every prompt must include the protagonist's fixed identity string (protagonist.identity_core) plus the age-stage descriptor for that shot.
rules.wardrobe_lock: The charcoal wool overcoat + white dress shirt + black trousers are worn in EVERY shot. Only wear/condition changes with age.
rules.no_text: No dialogue, subtitles, captions, logos or readable text in any shot.

protagonist.name: JIHO
protagonist.identity_core: a Korean man with a lean build, sharp jawline, narrow dark eyes with a faint double eyelid, straight nose, and a small distinctive mole just below the outer corner of his left eye, wearing a long charcoal wool overcoat over a white dress shirt with the top button undone and black trousers

A_20s.label: early 20s
A_20s.descriptor: early 20s, smooth youthful face, thick jet-black hair swept back and slightly windblown, bright hopeful eyes, upright energetic posture; overcoat crisp and new

B_30s.label: mid 30s
B_30s.descriptor: mid 30s, faint lines around the eyes, jet-black hair neatly swept back with a single streak of grey at the left temple, focused determined expression; overcoat slightly creased

C_40s.label: mid 40s
C_40s.descriptor: mid 40s, hair half grey at the temples, deeper lines on the forehead, tired but ambitious eyes, shoulders slightly tense; overcoat worn at the cuffs

D_50s.label: mid 50s
D_50s.descriptor: mid 50s, mostly silver-grey hair swept back, pronounced crow's feet, dignified weathered face, slightly stooped shoulders; overcoat faded with frayed hem

E_70s.label: early 70s
E_70s.descriptor: early 70s, thin white hair, deeply wrinkled gaunt face, sunken eyes, frail stooped body, slow careful movements; overcoat threadbare and dusty

the_woman.name: THE MUSE
the_woman.identity_core: an impossibly beautiful Korean woman with long straight jet-black hair reaching her waist, luminous pale skin, wearing a flowing champagne-gold silk gown with a long train that moves like liquid
the_woman.ideal_form: serene gentle smile, warm eyes, face softly lit and slightly out of focus, as if remembered rather than seen
the_woman.uncanny_form: the same woman but her skin has a faint porcelain sheen, her smile is fixed and symmetrical, her eyes are glassy and do not blink, her movements are a fraction too smooth, like a wind-up doll

the_crowd.identity_core: hundreds of guests in identical black tuxedos and black floor-length gowns, all wearing smooth featureless gold masks, applauding in perfect unison
the_crowd.uncanny_form: the guests repeat the exact same clap and bow in a mechanical loop, like animatronics, with jerky identical timing

family.identity_core: an elderly Korean mother and father in modest home clothes and a younger sister around ten years old, seated at a small kitchen table

friends.identity_core: three young Korean men in their early 20s in casual jackets, laughing at an orange-tented pojangmacha street food stall

props.crown: a thin minimalist crown of pure polished gold with no jewels
props.music_box: a small walnut music box with a tiny brass ballerina, its parts later seen shattered: gears, the ballerina, a comb of brass tines
props.family_photo: a creased Polaroid-style photograph of a family of four at a kitchen table
props.letters: handwritten letters on cream paper, folded, with no readable text (blurred ink)
